goal: Prevent duplicate address announcements across peers from falsely inflating address counts
Ensure address freshness checks properly account for time penalties on stored addresses
agreement: Unaddressed objection: check ordering blocks genuinely newer announcements (taki-abedesselam)
Requests documentation clarifying timestamp updates and multiplicity increases (danielabrozzoni)
Support because it reduces unwarranted address reference inflation on privacy nodes (stratospher)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a logic bug that inflates address counts upon identical gossip announcements
The fix keeps address counts accurate across peers during regular network gossip
Impact is limited because peers can still bypass it in adversarial scenarios by changing timestamps
